documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM
Addendum To The Boards'' Report For The Financial Year 2025-26 Which Forms An Integral Part Of The 34Th Annual Report

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited reported robust operational and financial performance for Q1 FY2026-27, driven by strong execution of Kavach railway safety systems. Management highlighted their comprehensive order book position, capacity scaling, and a structured diversification roadmap into new domains like yard management, intelligent traffic systems, and digital twins. The company maintains an optimistic long-term outlook backed by massive government rollouts and regulatory tailwinds for safety infrastructure. Kernex Microsystems reported its financial performance for Q3 FY25 and 9M FY25, highlighting significant revenue and EBITDA growth compared to the previous year. The management detailed ongoing railway safety and TCAS projects, order book metrics, production capacities, and timelines for new product developments such as TCAS 4.0 and NMS.

Expanding Fleet Baseline: Indian Railways adds ~approx 5 new locomotives daily
(~1,900+ per annum), continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.

rolling stock must be eventually outfitted with (ATP/ KAVACH) modules prior to commissioning.
